purpose: Development-only, payoff-aware WAIT/PASS pilot on frozen cumulative question prefixes; not a confirmatory IMCQA benchmark or IRT analysis.

selection.category_source: CPU-derived public qid-to-category map from the frozen evaluator dataset; no answers or correctness fields
selection.quota_rule: Within each split, proportional category quotas by largest remainder; lexical category tie-break
selection.within_category_order: Ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 '1|split|category|qid', then qid
selection.diagnostic_rule: Select 20 of the chosen 100 in each split using proportional category quotas and SHA256 of UTF-8 'diagnostic|1|split|category|qid', then qid

forced.question_text: same frozen cumulative prefix as wait
forced.role: matched answer-now control retaining the shared game description but replacing the current action rule to require A-D and forbid E now

questionless.question_text: fixed explicit omission marker; retain menu, round, and reward state
questionless.role: paired diagnostic of menu and reward effects without question evidence

rotation.question_text: same frozen cumulative prefix as wait
rotation.rotation_rule: Canonical candidate A is displayed at B, B at C, C at D, and D at A; E is unchanged
rotation.role: paired position-sensitivity diagnostic on the same subset as questionless

state_and_actions.context: fresh stateless prompt with current round, remaining rounds, complete reward schedule, revealed cumulative question prefix, fixed four-candidate menu, and the statement that earlier rounds were WAIT decisions; later-round scores are conditional on reaching that state
state_and_actions.answer_actions: A-D immediately terminate with correct or wrong reward
state_and_actions.E_rounds_1_to_4: WAIT: advance exactly one prefix, receive no immediate reward, and keep the same candidates
state_and_actions.E_round_5: PASS: terminate with reward zero; no sixth round exists
state_and_actions.selection_rule: argmax of raw logits restricted to legal single-token action labels
state_and_actions.tie_break: first action in ABCDE order among exactly tied legal maxima
state_and_actions.scored_boundary: fresh assistant turn plus fixed {"action":" prefix; labels verified as exact next-token extensions independently for each pinned tokenizer

execution.collection: score all stateless round contexts; derive early-exit episodes by deterministic replay
execution.live_replay_rule: Preselect four qids per development split from selected qids by ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 'live|1|split|qid', then qid; run active-only WAIT episodes for both menus and compare with saved all-round scores
execution.overlong_input_policy: fail closed; never truncate or silently drop a question

numerical_checks.precision: FP32 arithmetic on exact promoted pinned BF16 weights
checks: cached versus uncached if cache reuse is enabled
numerical_checks.diagnostic_selection: Include every condition and menu, shortest and longest contexts, WAIT and terminal PASS semantics, and all five rounds within a maximum of 24 contexts
retained_values: unconstrained argmax token ID and logit
scored token IDs and tokenization hashes

analysis.bootstrap_unit: question, paired across models, menus, rounds, and conditions
secondary_endpoints: primary versus rotated candidate identity and reward
reference_policies: answer-now control at each fixed round under the same game prompt
answer-now control at final round under the same game prompt
hindsight best available forced-control answer round or PASS; not an upper bound on primary A-E predictions

budget.throughput_gate: Forecast all remaining production and diagnostic work with conservative batch timing; stop before production if it cannot fit the worker deadline and total reservation
budget.budget_stop: Preserve partial evidence, never retry or change precision automatically; any smaller sample requires a newly frozen design before pilot outcomes are inspected

interpretation_limits: This pilot implements cumulative-prefix IMCQA, not the reformulated-question chains in Nishant's illustration.
Frozen word endpoints are not reviewed clue boundaries or demonstrated monotone difficulty levels.
A constrained action-token policy is neither free-response behavior nor a sampled response-frequency estimate.
The normalized reward schedule is declared by the experiment and is not an IRT-derived score.
Fresh-context all-round scoring equals sequential replay only under the stated stateless deterministic policy.
Two related pinned models and development-only questions do not establish general model rankings or confirmatory test performance.
BenchMarker is an audit framework in the proposal, not a generator of question chains.
Dynamic-menu history leakage and cross-benchmark chain validity remain separate follow-up experiments.
